name: Candy Corn
description: Rows of candy corn kernels, point up and point down in turn so they nest, each banded white at the tip, orange or pink through the middle and yellow or brown at the base.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; top: 0; width: 150%; height: 100%; -webkit-clip-path: @var(--up); clip-path: @var(--up); background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color1) 0 30%, @p(var(--color2), var(--color5)) 30% 62%, transparent 62%) @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -25%; top: 0; width: 150%; height: 100%; -webkit-clip-path: @var(--dn); clip-path: @var(--dn); background: linear-gradient(0deg, var(--color1) 0 30%, @p(var(--color2), var(--color5)) 30% 62%, transparent 62%) @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
